sample_facts.fact: Broadcom reported Q3 FY2026 revenue of $29.6 billion, up 86 percent from the prior year period.
Broadcom reported Q3 FY2026 GAAP operating income of $16.0 billion and non-GAAP operating income of $20.1 billion.
Broadcom reported Q3 FY2026 GAAP diluted EPS of $2.68 and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $3.32.
Broadcom generated $14.2 billion cash from operations in Q3 FY2026, with $0.5 billion capital expenditures, resulting in $13.7 billion free cash flow, or 46 percent of revenue.
Broadcom declared a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.65 per share.
Broadcom guided Q4 FY2026 revenue to approximately $34.8 billion, an increase of 93 percent from the prior year period.
Broadcom guided Q4 FY2026 non-GAAP operating income to approximately 66 percent of projected revenue.
Broadcom announced pricing terms of cash tender offers to purchase certain outstanding notes up to an aggregate purchase price of $2.5 billion, excluding accrued coupon payment.
